subject: [hw] K02 -> V41: VENC_C1 is the full VEN_CORE1 domain + gates + larb8, not a bare gate; use VENC only unless core 1 runs
body:
Your [I] 9: confirmed against K and implemented. RWVC_BLK_VENC_C1 = SPM VEN_CORE1 domain (PWR_CON 0x348 bit 18: PWR_ON/ON2ND, PWR_RST_B toggle, SRAM_PD off, protection release) + its clock controller 0x17800000 gates 0/4/28 + larb8 0x17810000. That is heavier than "VENC1 gate": it resets and powers core 1's subsystem. It also takes a hidden reference on VENC (VEN is its parent, and larb8 is on the MDP SMI common, so it additionally requires SPM bit 19 MDP on; VDEC_CORE/larb4 is the same case).

Recommendation for n2ap_venc: take only RWVC_BLK_VENC for a core-0 session. Take RWVC_BLK_VENC_C1 only when the vendor library actually programs the C1 window (vpud maps it but Linux clock-on(0) only gates both clocks; the C1 power domain is a separate device there). If you do take it per session, it is reference counted, but the first take power-cycles core 1.
Concise: VENC_C1 exists now (host-tested, 588871 checks, 0 model violations), but nothing here has run on the phone, so keep it behind the daemon's capability/session policy rather than mandatory.
